evidence.reason: The runbook binds Effects to its own per-run directory and performs the switch flow itself rather than using the controller's deploy_plan. It therefore does not apply the controller's refuse_unfinished_transactions guard against the controller record directory before changing the checkout, so a leftover checkout or unit-switch transaction can remain unrecovered while the runbook switches. This is a routine safety defect in the existing deploy flow; the minimal fix is to run that guard on an Effects bound to the controller record directory and refuse before helper.switch.
